question: We are in dbt Cloud. Many times (especially for incremental models) I would like to run a model only one time with a specific set of parameters, which I don't want to push into the main branch. I would like to test a dbt run in a development environment and then I would like to run the same code in production. Same, meaning that all the ref() functions and so on use the production schema instead.
title: Run a model in production schema from development environment
answer:
There is no way to do this directly. Some options:

  1. Compile your code from development, switch out the databases and schemas, and then run the code in your data warehouse.
  2. Create a new environment in dbt Cloud pointing to your branch, and configure that environment with your production credentials. Run a dbt job from that environment.
  3. If there are specific parameters you're switching out, then set those up as either variables or environment variables in your code. You can then run a production job in your existing production environment with the desired value (by updating the environment variable, or if using a normal variable, by defining the value in your command).
